---
title: "03 — Efficacy analysis"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(broom)

adsl <- read_csv(
  here("data", "processed", "adsl_clean.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

eff <- read_csv(
  here("data", "processed", "adqsadas_clean.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

trt <- intersect(c("trt01p", "trt01a"), names(adsl))[1]

required <- c(
  "usubjid",
  "aval",
  "base",
  "chg",
  "avisit",
  "avisitn",
  "param",
  "paramcd",
  "anl01fl"
)

if (is.na(trt) || !all(required %in% names(eff))) {
  stop("Confirm endpoint, visit, treatment and analysis-flag mappings.")
}
```

```{r}
# EDIT after inspecting metadata; never choose a visit solely because it looks favorable.
endpoint_code <- "ADASCOG"
final_visit <- "Week 24"

analysis <- eff |>
  filter(paramcd == endpoint_code, avisit == final_visit) |>
  inner_join(adsl |> select(usubjid, all_of(trt), any_of(c("age", "sex"))), by = "usubjid")
if (!nrow(analysis)) stop("Endpoint/visit selection returned zero rows; inspect PARAMCD and AVISIT values")
```

```{r}
trajectory <- eff |> filter(paramcd == endpoint_code) |>
  inner_join(adsl |> select(usubjid, all_of(trt)), by = "usubjid") |>
  group_by(.data[[trt]], avisit, avisitn) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(aval, na.rm = TRUE), se = sd(aval, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(sum(!is.na(aval))), .groups = "drop")

p <- ggplot(trajectory, aes(avisitn, mean, color = .data[[trt]])) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean-se, ymax = mean+se), width = .2) +
  labs(x = "Analysis visit", y = "Mean ADAS-Cog score", color = "Treatment") + theme_minimal()
ggsave(here("outputs", "figures", "efficacy_trajectory.png"), p, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
model_formula <- reformulate(c(trt, "base", intersect(c("age", "sex"), names(analysis))), response = "chg")
model <- lm(model_formula, data = analysis)
tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) |> write_csv(here("outputs", "tables", "efficacy_model.csv"))
tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE)
```

Interpret the sign only after confirming the score direction and treatment reference level. Discuss effect size, confidence interval, available-case assumptions, and exploratory multiplicity.
